in_sanskrit.name: आयुष
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The Sanskrit name 'Ayush' is derived from the Sanskrit root 'ayu' which means 'life'. The name is often used as a synonym for the God of life, Yama. It is also used as a name for the Lord of Ayodhya, Rama. The name 'Ayush' signifies the blessings of a long and healthy life.
